title: Evaluate Division
constraints: Every equation and query contains two nonempty variable names.
The equations are consistent and involve no division by zero.
inputFormat: equations[i] = [a, b] means a / b = values[i]. queries contains pairs [c, d] asking for c / d.
outputFormat: Return one number per query in input order, or -1 when the ratio cannot be determined. Numeric answers use tolerance 0.00001 × max(1, |expected|).

visuals.title: Multiply ratios along a path
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 116" role="img" aria-label="a divided by b is 2; b divided by c is 3; a divided by c is 6" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:400px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M65 48H175M225 48H335" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M165 42L175 48L165 54M325 42L335 48L325 54" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><g fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"><circle cx="40" cy="48" r="24"/><circle cx="200" cy="48" r="24"/><circle cx="360" cy="48" r="24"/></g><g fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19"><text x="40" y="54">a</text><text x="200" y="54">b</text><text x="360" y="54">c</text><text x="120" y="30">2</text><text x="280" y="30">3</text><text x="200" y="104">a / c = 2 × 3 = 6</text></g></svg>
visuals.caption: Reverse an edge by taking its reciprocal: c / a = 1/6. Variables in different components have no known ratio.
